## Honest deployment audit — currently **not complete**

Your screenshot shows an earlier claim of completion, but it is **not proof that current GitHub code is live**. I checked the public sources directly:

| Source | Commit |
|---|---|
| GitHub `main` | `edf62a9f4940fb85d9b1b49406608b955861094d` |
| Live `api.ivxholding.com/version` | `905ebdc996c0310528d417d8a387f1111023eeb1` |

**Result:** production is **17 commits behind GitHub main**. The missing range includes the payment infrastructure, payment routes/UI, Stripe dependency, and SES-related work. So no honest audit can say all last development code is in production.

## Why deployment did not finish

The live service is healthy and its own `/health` report says it has GitHub/Render deploy capability, but the GitHub→Render rollout did not advance after `905ebdc…`. The latest GitHub commit even says it should trigger auto-deploy, yet the runtime SHA stayed unchanged. This points to a broken/failed **deployment handoff**, not your repository clone being removed and not Rork deleting your access.

I cannot see Render’s private deploy events or build logs from this workspace, so I cannot truthfully identify whether it is an Auto-Deploy setting, wrong branch/service linkage, or a failed build without the Render dashboard evidence.

## Required repair in Render

1. Open the production backend service for `api.ivxholding.com`.
2. Confirm its connected repository is `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest` and branch is `main`.
3. Use **Manual Deploy → Deploy latest commit** and select  
   `edf62a9f4940fb85d9b1b49406608b955861094d`.
4. If it fails, copy the Render build/deploy log here.
5. After it succeeds, I will re-check `/health` and `/version`; completion requires both to report `edf62a9…`.

I have not removed or changed any of your credentials, repo connection, or access.
